node.label: Arjun Appadurai
node.date_label: 1986: The Social Life of Things (editor), including his Introduction: Commodities and the Politics of Value · 1996: Modernity at Large: Cultural Dimensions of Globalization · 2006: Fear of Small Numbers: An Essay on the Geography of Anger
node.description: A social and cultural anthropologist whose work connects exchange, migration and the cultural dimensions of globalization. He examines how circulation produces value and how moving people maintain and transform identities, rather than treating cultures as bounded, static wholes.
node.representative_figures_and_works: The Social Life of Things (editor), including his Introduction: Commodities and the Politics of Value (1986); Modernity at Large: Cultural Dimensions of Globalization (1996); Fear of Small Numbers: An Essay on the Geography of Anger (2006).
